premise: A warm, funny children's adventure novel for [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO], who turns ten today. [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] is curious, collects smooth stones, and is afraid of the dark though he will not admit it. His scruffy terrier Bruno sleeps at the foot of his bed. The summer before this one he found a fossil on the beach at Cadaques and named it Captain Crunch. In the garden stands the cardboard observatory he built with his grandfather. [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO] has always wondered what is on the other side of the hill behind the house. This is the summer he goes to find out.
tone: a warm, funny children's adventure - a read-aloud summer quest told close to the ground, brave and kind; small real wonders rather than magic, a dog who is a character, and a fear of the dark taken seriously and gently
privacy: The buyer's child's given name is withheld under the organisation's data-protection policy and appears in every artefact as the literal token [NOMBRE_ANONIMIZADO]. One find-and-replace restores it locally.
